title: Reframe — What You Would Do Differently

timed_text.text: We did a reframe exercise earlier in the series. Today. We go deeper
You've added tool since then like your reset word your if then plan yourself talk replacements
Your mistake protocol the fighter mindset your focus anchors trained
I want you to go back to a different moment
Competition that didn't go the way you wanted where your mind got in the way
When you've carried as a failure
We're going to replay it not to relive the pain but to rewrite the response
You're not pretending the bad moment didn't happen
You're showing your nervous system that you now have a trained answer to the moment that used to have none
Every time you do this that memory loses its charge and the next time something similar arrives your brain looks for the trained response
Not the old pattern think of a moment that still stings a little yeah, that's the one on your screen you're gonna walk through it

cards.prompt: Describe the moment — the situation, what happened, what your mind did, and how it affected your performance.
At what exact point did the spiral begin? What was the trigger thought?
Replay it with your full toolkit. From that exact moment — walk through what you would have done. Every step. Reset word, physical cue, focus anchor, self-talk replacement. Be specific.
Read your reframed response back. This is your trained answer to that moment now.

timed_text.text: So look that memory just became an actual rep and the next time something like it arrives
look you've already been there with a plan next you've got a journal and after you finish day 26 is complete
